\section{\texttt{VectorStore}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.vector_store.VectorStore}\index{Classes!VectorStore}

Interface shared by every vector store backend.
\apifield{Inherits}\texttt{Protocol}
\apifield{Attributes}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{dim}] \texttt{int}, required
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Properties}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{size}] Number of indexed chunks.
  \item[\texttt{chunks}] Return the indexed chunks.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}Both the default \texttt{InMemoryVectorStore} (JSON persistence) and the optional Qdrant-backed store satisfy this protocol, so the retrieval layer can treat them interchangeably. Vectors are assumed to be L2-normalised and scored by cosine similarity, with higher scores meaning more similar.
